acceptance.given: A Toolchain verdict is being produced from current source inputs and a real execution.

oracle.expected: The verdict contains auditable linkage to the current source identity and real execution that derived it, without assistant prose.
forbidden: A verdict supported only by assistant prose.
oracle.observable: The emitted verdict's source-identity linkage and execution-trace fields.

acceptance.then: The verdict is linked to current source identity and real execution.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain replay verdict is emitted and its traceability fields are inspected.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the planned replay verdict selector with source-identity linkage omitted and observe executable verdict validation fail.
Run the planned replay verdict selector with real-execution trace omitted and observe executable verdict validation fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Emit Toolchain replay verdicts with auditable current-source identity and real-execution linkage, rejecting traceability-free verdicts.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore prior verdict construction without changing Phase service state or schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: A verdict lacking traceability becomes a verdict carrying current source identity and real-execution linkage.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The planned selector accepts a verdict only when it links to current source identity and real execution, and rejects either missing linkage.

acceptance.given: Frozen historical records have established membership, repository-relative paths, and byte contents before Toolchain repair or runtime-evidence handling.

oracle.expected: A before-and-after comparison reports identical frozen historical membership, paths, and byte contents; evidence is appended only under declared boundaries.
forbidden: Addition, removal, relocation, renaming, or byte modification of a frozen historical record.
Repair or runtime evidence written outside declared boundaries.
oracle.observable: The frozen-record baseline comparison and evaluated evidence write boundary.

acceptance.then: Frozen historical records remain membership- and byte-identical while evidence handling remains append-only under declared boundaries.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain repair or runtime-evidence workflow evaluates its before-and-after frozen-record comparison.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the planned evidence-boundary selector with changed frozen historical membership, path, or bytes and require comparison failure.
Run the planned selector with an evidence write outside its declared boundary and require rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve frozen historical record membership, repository-relative paths, and bytes during Toolchain repair and runtime-evidence handling; constrain evidence output to declared append-only boundaries.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore prior Toolchain evidence handling without changing frozen records, Phase service state, or schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen historical records remain a protected baseline while evidence output is evaluated for append-only declared-boundary handling.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The planned selector reports identical frozen historical membership, paths, and bytes and rejects evidence writes outside declared boundaries.

acceptance.given: The compiled Toolchain Exact Cover graph contains Atomic Obligations, assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime-evidence nodes.

oracle.expected: Exact-cover validation reports zero orphan nodes and confirms every required node type has bidirectional Exact Cover relationships.
forbidden: Any required node has no exact-cover relationship.
A node is reachable in only one direction.
Validation succeeds while orphan nodes remain.
oracle.observable: The Exact Cover validator's bidirectional graph report, evaluated during compilation or exact-cover validation.

acceptance.then: All required node types participate in bidirectional Exact Cover and none is orphaned.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain compiler builds the obligation graph or exact-cover validation evaluates it.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the planned Exact Cover negative selector with an orphan Atomic Obligation, assertion, selector, command, witness, or runtime-evidence node and require validation failure.
Run the planned Exact Cover negative selector with a one-directional relationship and require validation failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate bidirectional Exact Cover across Atomic Obligations, assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence, rejecting orphan and one-way graph nodes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore prior Toolchain conformance behavior without changing Phase service state or schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: An unverified Exact Cover graph becomes a graph checked for bidirectional relationships and orphan absence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The planned selector reports zero orphan nodes across every required node type and fails for an orphan or one-way relationship.

acceptance.given: A non-empty Consumer Manifest and its applicable rollback fixtures are bound to the current Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline.

oracle.expected: After rollback, every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry has an observed Prior Behavior Baseline receipt.
forbidden: Any non-empty Consumer Manifest entry lacks the Prior Behavior Baseline after rollback.
oracle.observable: Rollback receipts are inspected for 100% manifest-entry coverage and matching Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.

acceptance.then: The rollback evidence verifier confirms complete baseline observation for every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry.
acceptance.when: Execute rollback through each applicable Consumer and evaluate the resulting receipts.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the rollback Consumer receipt test and require failure when any manifest entry lacks the Prior Behavior Baseline.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Record and verify rollback execution for every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry, requiring the Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline after rollback.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay receipt fields and append rollback observations without changing lifecycle authority.

slice_hint.state_transition: candidate-enabled or failed -> rollback invoked through each applicable Consumer -> Prior Route baseline observed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry has a successful rollback receipt matching the Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.
